Name: Open At First Light
Author: exsomet
Description:
[b]What is this?
[/b]This mod causes shops in Pelican Town to open at 7:00AM. It does not change closing times, days that shops are open, or any prerequisites to enter them (such as the adventure guild). It [i]only[/i] modifies the time that they open. Pierre's will still be closed on Wednesdays.

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]ContentPatcher
[/list]
[b]Which shops are affected?[/b]
[list]
[*]Blacksmith (Clint)
[*]Carpenter (Robin)
[*]Fishing Shop (Willy)
[*]Animal Shop (Marnie)
[*]Seed Shop (Pierre)
[*]Oasis (Sandy)
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Open At First Light
Manifest.Description: Modifies shopkeeper schedules to open their shops earlier
Manifest.Author: Exsomet
